additions.group: 小型・多言語エンコーダ／蒸留比較
additions.reason_selected: Independent pruned and distilled student of 450M, publisher 500B training tokens; complete BF16 MLM state with untied head, 16k context; low-resource multilingual classification/NER adaptation and teacher-student compression comparison. Not a quantization and no teacher weight required for inference.
additions.quality_positive: Publisher Indic 7-task mean 67.37 vs IndicBERT-v2 66.57; 5/7 tasks better; English 10-task mean 62.20 vs ModernBERT-base 60.69 (fixed card).
additions.quality_negative: Publisher slot filling 54 vs 58.1 and QA 46 vs 48.3 for IndicBERT-v2; English mean 62.20 vs UltraBERT-150M 64.59; blog narrative differs from fixed card. Not Japanese; no owner matched hardware replication.
additions.risk_and_alternative_assessment: KEEP ModernBERT-large as English control; KEEP BGE-M3 and Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B trained retrieval states. Nandi is MLM requiring task adaptation, not drop-in retrieval. Custom Transformers 5.x code, ABI, owner rights and offline restore unresolved. No safety-evasion criterion.
